[EN] As a job, guarding researchers is somewhere between infant care and herding terrons. They're not supposed to leave camp without an escort, but they always manage to sneak away. At least they don't usually get themselves lost....
[ES] Como trabajo, proteger a los investigadores está a medio camino entre cuidar bebés y pastorear terrons. Supuestamente no deben abandonar el campamento sin escolta, pero siempre se las arreglan para escaparse sigilosamente. Al menos por lo general no se pierden...
